label: Oh My Pi
profileRootNote: not HOME/.omp/profiles: that path is omp's own named-profile layout (~/.omp/profiles/<name>/agent), and a seat directory is an agent directory, not a profile.

settings.sourceNote: the seat's omp settings file is YAML, and JSON is valid YAML, so the kit writes and verifies it with jq like every other settings file.
settings.ownedPathsNote: keys setup replaces whole instead of merging, because a merge cannot take back a deny or a pattern the kit no longer sets. Every other key in the seat's file is merged and kept, so anything omp writes for itself survives.
settings.limitsNote: a seat's tool limits are omp settings, verified on 18.1.19 against a scratch agent directory in --approval-mode yolo, the mode Paseo launches these seats in. eval.py and eval.js false with task.maxRecursionDepth 0 take eval, task and hub out of the tool list; web_search, fetch, debug, lsp and browser with enabled false take theirs out, and fetch is the part of read that opens URLs. tools.approval deny refuses a call but leaves the tool listed. bash.patterns deny refuses a command whose text matches, with * as the only wildcard, so *git push* also catches a push after cd or behind a variable; a deny wins over an allow for the same command, so the watcher, which reads paseo logs, denies the other paseo subcommands by name instead of the whole CLI. Matching is on the command text, which makes it a rail against the habitual form, not a sandbox: omp has no filesystem sandbox, so where a Peer writes is the brief's owned scope.
settings.skillsNote: skills and skillful are pinned, not left to defaults. enablePiUser keeps the seat directory this kit fills; every other discovery root is off, because a repository ships .omp/skills, .claude/skills and .agent/skills of its own and HOME/.agents/skills is shared, and a skill arriving that way was never checked against this seat hidesWords or its skill set. Measured with omp config get on this machine: enablePiProject, enableClaudeProject, enableAgentsUser and enableAgentsProject all default to true, and a project-level skill was seen in a seat system prompt alongside the kit ones. skillful true is what puts the list in the system prompt at all.
settings.roleSourceNote: a per-role overlay merged over settings.json, for a key one seat needs its own value for. Only differences belong here: a key every seat on this harness shares stays in settings.json, where it cannot drift, and a role with no file here takes the shared file unchanged. An owned path is an array or map the overlay replaces whole, so a role that changes bash.patterns repeats the shared patterns it keeps. compaction.thresholdTokens is the owner's to pick per seat rather than anything the kit derives: the model window is only the ceiling it must stay under, and zai/glm-5.3 reports 1M. Verified in the omp binary rather than taken from the key name: My() returns min(contextWindow - 1, thresholdTokens) and SO() compacts once tokens exceed it, so the number is the compaction point itself, with no offset. Left unset, the default is the window minus max(15% of it, 16384), which on a 1M window would only compact at 850k.

state.mcpNote: $servers is seats.json's mcpServers map, passed in by setup-seats.fish. This file is the seat's user-scope MCP config, and writing the whole object replaces anything else in it. omp also reads a repository's own .omp/mcp.json and the other tools' project files, which this does not reach.

probe.live: run probe.command with the seat's configDirEnv set and ask it to list its skills
probe.note: the skills directory, the prompt file and the settings keys were verified by running a seat against a scratch agent directory; a version other than the verified one re-opens those questions

provider.defaultModelNote: the model a role on this harness gets when seats.json names none and --model is not passed. Spelled the way this harness spells a model: omp wants provider/id.

baseCredential.note: set on the base provider so every seat inherits it through extends. A seat directory is its own agent directory with its own empty credential store, so the seat authenticates from this variable and never shares omp's login database. The kit never reads it from anywhere but the user.

provider.commandNote: every harness launches through the shared room, which forces forceFlags and execs the binary in provider.env.SEATWORKS_AGENT_BIN. The Paseo plugin, not the room, resolves the project from the agent's working directory and sets configDirEnv to that project's seat directory, because a provider's env is the same for every project.

promptCommentsNote: informational. Every .md in this kit is comment-free so it loads unchanged on every harness; setup refuses `<!--` whatever this says. A safety review reads it to know whether a leaked note would reach the seat.
sharedSkillDirsNote: removed: HOME/.agents/skills is no longer a shared root for this harness, because settings.json pins skills.enableAgentsUser to false. Restore the field only if that pin is dropped, since setup reports the directory as reaching every seat when a harness declares it.
